$Comment: Inkwell_Chicken_Annoying — a chicken with mood swings: it randomly alternates between circling the nearest player (annoying) and ordinary wandering (default), holding each mode for a random number of seconds before re-rolling. This is driven by a single built-in 'Type: Random' instruction with 'ExecuteFor': [min, max] (see vanilla Test_Random_Instruction.json); no custom code is needed beyond the Inkwell_Orbit BodyMotion. A self-contained 'Generic' role (NOT a Variant): a Variant's Modify block runs values through the expression system and rejects a structural Instructions array, so the behavior must be defined at the role's top level. Reuses the vanilla Chicken appearance (referenced vanilla id, no Inkwell_ prefix). Inkwell_Orbit is a custom BodyMotion registered by InkwellPlugin.setup().

MaxHealth.Description: Max health for the annoying chicken

Instructions.$Comment: Annoying branch. Top-level Sensor is Any so the Random node's per-tick matches() always passes (otherwise a Player-sensor branch picked with no player in range would idle for the whole window). The orbit-vs-wander choice is a nested fallthrough: orbit a sensed player, else wander.
